purpose: Opt-in live harness environment with persistent installation, explicit updates and private operator authentication.
limitations: Vendor harnesses are installed on initialization, not bundled in the image; first installation needs the documented vendor endpoints.
The persistent HOME contains private authentication state and must not be shared or published.
Reproduction requires the image digest, exact installed harness versions and consumer source revision; the image digest alone does not identify runtime-installed tools.
Live model acceptance is operator-run and paid; image readiness never authenticates or calls a model.
Use a dedicated persistent HOME for one operator and UID; root runs also retain HOME=/home/dev in this image.

changes: Add an opt-in Python, Node and tmux environment with persistent harness installation, inspection, explicit updates and rollback.
trixie.migration: New opt-in line. Use a dedicated private HOME volume, inspect exact runtime installation receipts, and run credential-free readiness before operator authentication.
